An Act to amend

[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
10th February,
1998]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 7th
February, 1998, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Contempt of Court (Amendment)
Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force with
effect from the first day of November, 1997.

Amendment of section 10, Act LXIV of 1976

ACT II OF 1998
ACT II OF 1998
CONTEMPT OF COURT
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act to amend
the Contempt
of Court Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
10th February,
1998]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 7th
February, 1998, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 10,
Act LXIV of 1976.--In the Contempt of Court Act, 1976 (LXIV of 1976), in
section 10,--
(i) after subsection (2) the
following new subsection shall be inserted, namely:--
"(2-A) An intra-Court appeal
shall lie against the issuance of a show cause notice or an original order
including an interim order passed by a Bench of the Supreme Court in any case,
including a pending case, to a larger Bench consisting of all the remaining
available Judges of the Court within the country:
Provided that in the event the
impugned show-cause notice or order has been passed by half or more of the
Judges of the Court, the matter shall, on the application of an aggrieved
person, be put up for re-appraisal before the full Court:
Provided further that the
operation of the impugned show-cause notice or order shall remain suspended
until the final disposal of the matter in the manner hereinbefore
provided"; and
(ii) after subsection (3) the
following new subsection shall be added, namely:--
"(4) An
intra-Court appeal or application for re-appraisal shall be filed within thirty
days from the date of show-cause notice or the order, as the case may
be.".
